metadata.name: fading remnants
metadata.description:
[h2]Mod Overview[/h2] This mod automatically removes redundant entities, including: - Opened chests - Broken Blood Donation Machines - Broken Fortune Telling Machines - Broken Slot Machines - Broken Restock Machines and more.
I created this mod because piles of opened chests spawned by the D20 are quite annoying, along with leftover item pedestals generated by Genesis, D6 and Void items.
[h3]Customization[/h3] If you install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Steam Workshop - Mod Config Menu[/url], you can fully tweak the fade-out animation settings of this mod.
[h3]Bug Reports & Feedback[/h3] If you run into any bugs, feel free to leave a comment below, or submit an issue on my [url=https://github.com/changchanggod/MyIsaacMods]GitHub repository[/url]. All feedback is appreciated.
